title: File collection can read outside the workspace
reasoning: Direct and glob-matched files pass is_file(), which follows symlinks, without the symlink exclusion used for recursive directory collection. relative_to() is lexical and does not establish containment. A generated output symlink can consequently expose a host-readable file outside the workspace. Internal parent traversal such as subdir/../../outside.txt is also not rejected.
reproduction: Create a harmless file outside the workspace and a workspace output.txt symlink pointing to it. get_file_contents(['output.txt']) or get_file_contents(['*.txt']) returns the external contents.
recommendation: Apply a consistent containment and symlink policy to every collection branch. Reject parent traversal and prevent reads through paths resolving outside the workspace.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The symlink test covers only symlinks encountered during recursive directory collection, not literal paths, glob matches, symlinked parent directories, or traversal.
suggestedRegressionTest: Expand file collection scenarios across literal, glob, and directory requests with external symlink targets and parent traversal; assert no external contents are returned.
minimumFixScope: Workspace.get_file_contents path validation and candidate selection.
